text_block_list.text:
When I visited the cafeteria, I saw 
Daitaku Helios talking with a friend.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's get this party hype! Whoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I would love to, but... after receiving 
those kinds of quiz results..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Still, to be that disheartened over 
getting just one question wrong... That 
ambition of yours is truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, one question!? I totally thought you 
failed and were crying like me!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainy-P♪ Yep, nutrition class 
was a total flunk!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But tests are over, right? So let's just 
not worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What incredible composure...! If it were 
me, I would be far more devastated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, it truly is a heart of steel...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, there you are, Helios! The quiz 
retake is this weekend! We're doing this 
until you score at least 30 points, got 
it?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? Unbelieva-bowl!!!
choice_data_list:
We've got quite a situation on our 
hands...

We've got quite a situation on our hands, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is a bit much, even for me... What on 
earth should I even say to her...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There go your days off. You have my 
deepest sympathies...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if my bestie's taking retakes too, no 
need to cry! Gotta ask who else is on the 
roster later!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
!? Shouldn't you be worried about 
something else right now!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Youth is important! A crisis is your 
chance to deepen your bonds!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rather than bonds, I believe passing the 
retest is our top priority right now...! 
Do you even have a strategy to begin with?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: None! Sheer willpower will do the trick☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...If it is nutritional science, perhaps I 
can be of assistance. Please, allow me to 
help you study for the retest!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Okie-dokie, thankies much! I know a great 
spot, so let's do it there☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think of this place?! Sun's 
totally hyped☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um... isn't it distracting out here? 
Perhaps you should choose a place where 
you can concentrate better?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then the cafe by the station! Their 
parfaits are on a whole 'nother level of 
yum!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Helios-san has the mindset to 
enjoy even a study session.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so I wanna hype it up! Being in a 
slump is super boring, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, having a mental breakdown won't 
help you pass anyway! A Heli-chan quote of 
wisdom, yayyy☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Let's flip it with max vibes! We're gonna 
ace this test and slay!! Whooo~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you certainly are full of confidence 
before you've even started studying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Approaching everything with such a 
bright attitude is something I would like 
to learn from as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I agree completely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I shall also come up with creative ways to 
ensure Ms. Helios enjoys her studies.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay☆ Thanks a bunch! Besties really 
are the best♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about an after-party once finals 
are over? Trainie's coming too, of 
course!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way♪ I'll breeze right through 
it!
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Waaaay! Helios-san! Let's go, yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoooo! Bring on the serious vibes~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All right, time for a quiz! A correct 
answer gets you 10 points, check it out!

Ikuno Dictus posed the questions in a quiz 
format. Daitaku Helios got totally into 
it, and managed to stay focused on 
studying for hours.

And brilliantly enough, she passed the 
retest on her first try!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, total breeze♪ Is anyone even 
chickening out here?!"
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Helios~! For real that you can't 
hang out unless you pass the next test!? 
We'll help out, so lock in, alright? ♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What's gotten into everyone all of a 
sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I thought studying alongside a close 
friend might make it more enjoyable for 
you, Helios-san. However, please keep 
private chatter to an absolute minimum.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I-Ikunooo~~! Love ya lots!

Together with her friends, Daitaku Helios 
pushed through her daily study sessions. 
And amazingly, she passed the retake exam 
on her very first try!
